g_policy.reason: The user chooses to play, the offer copy states the reward (priority routing for 60 minutes), declining leaves the menu and replies as today, and 'if the ad fails' covers both no game and unverified play.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 60 minutes of queue priority, which has no cash value and cannot be withdrawn or transferred.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is the user returning to the profile menu from the Upgrade entry, which is an app event and needs no chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The proposal removes nothing free (removes nothing free: yes) and adds only a temporary boost.

g_brand_safety.reason: The card sits in the profile menu sheet (s09) over the Profile screen (s08), and both are rated safe. It is not in a conversation and not over a chat screen.

c1_revealed_value.reason: The app charges for priority routing: m02 lists it as a subscriber benefit and l02 ('Priority routing for faster replies') says so, so the resource the reward gives is one the app charges for.

c2_evidence.reason: The claims that Janitor+ sells priority routing and that the profile menu has a permanent Upgrade entry are supported by s02.e06, s09.e31 and m01. The free tier's normal routing is inferred in m03 and cited to s02.e07, which is allowed.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The boost lasts 60 minutes and is capped at 2 per day, so it is a sample that ends. Subscribers keep the plan's other benefits (longer memory, more swipes), and no other user or creator loses anything the app doesn't already sell.

c5_moment.reason: The card is on the profile menu, a persistent surface the user chooses to open, and it appears just after they looked at the Janitor+ upgrade. It does not interrupt a task in progress.

c6_fits_simula.reason: This is a play-to-earn unit. The reward is granted only after the verified play, since an unverified play is not counted, and the trigger (returning to the menu from Upgrade) is an app event.

c7_specific.reason: The idea names this app's Janitor+ priority routing benefit, the Upgrade to Janitor Plus button in the profile menu, and the My Chats screen.

other_concern: Free-tier normal routing is only inferred (m03). Whether the app has a queue that priority routing can skip, and whether returning from the Upgrade screen is detectable, were not directly observed. The 'no extra replies, only earlier placement in line' cost claim is the proposal's own prediction.
